# Play Podcast

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Subscribes to the Podcast at the given feed url in Apple Podcasts.

## Syntax

~~~~text
playPodcast(podcast: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
playPodcast(podcast: Launched #2)
~~~~
